text: Point Nemo turns your lesson PDF into a local underwater study adventure.
Choose one English, text-based PDF from your local library.
The safety gate checks the file and its signature before local processing
Local Ollama creates nine questions, then validation checks answers against
Explore three topics on your ocean map.
Clear each encounter to unlock the next.
Miss a question, and see the correct answer, an explanation, and the exact
supporting quote with its PDF page.
Then face the final review: the same nine questions, shuffled.
Get eight right to complete the run.
See your result, and try the lesson again.
